fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/tui/autonomyapp with a fake runner: the four fields start at the values daemon.settings gives, submitting calls daemon.set once per changed toggle and none for unchanged ones, then quits; Esc calls nothing; the tui-autonomy-app testscript's --once still prints what rhiza daemon settings --json prints.
fields.statement: The Autonomy app is one rexuikit Form of the plan, accept, ship and sign-off toggles, each auto or owner, prefilled from daemon.settings; submitting writes each changed toggle (rhiza.autonomy.plan, accept, ship, signoff) through daemon.set and closes the app.
